title: Vex (Neon Requiem drummer) is STILL posting about the band like they didn't break up 10 months ago
body:
Check his blog. Every single post is about Neon Requiem reunion rumors, the "legendary" final show, or cryptic hints about new music.

THE BAND IS OVER VEX. The frontman moved to Portland. The bassist is in dental school. It's done.

Someone needs to stage an intervention.

comments.content: We're just on hiatus. There's a difference. The final show wasn't "final" it was "legendary." Those are different words with different meanings.

replies.content: Vex the frontman's Instagram bio literally says "former member of Neon Requiem"
